title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Wednesday, 14 October 2026
description: OpenAI and Anthropic reportedly move ahead with stock market listing plans as Anthropic details blocked attempts to misuse its Claude models, the NDIS reform rollout enters a new staged phase, Queensland names its first new schools and starts work on a $98M Sunshine Coast primary school, and the Gold Coast unveils new bus routes and a 20-year transport plan. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
